description: A composed policy that accepts a claim only if (a) the issuer is not revoked, (b) the subject is not revoked, AND (c) at least 2 of 3 corroborating attestations are themselves unrevoked. Demonstrates revocation-aware composition and quorum voting over the resolved graph.

pass.comment: Issuer and subject both unrevoked; 3 of 3 corroborators unrevoked; no cycles.

fail-revoked-issuer.comment: Issuer is revoked; fails before corroborators are evaluated due to short-circuit.

fail-quorum.comment: Both issuer and subject unrevoked, but only 1 of 3 corroborators is unrevoked.

fail-cycle.comment: A claim references a parent that transitively references back to the root claim.

notes: Rules are evaluated in declared order unless composition.shortCircuitOnFail=false.
RevocationCheck uses Status List 2021 bitstring entries; entries older than revocationLookbackSeconds are ignored to bound cache staleness.
Quorum's candidateClaims may be passed by reference (list above) or by a selector query, e.g. { 'tag': 'corroborates', 'subject': '$rootClaim.subject' }.
This policy composes cleanly with the existing cycle-detection-policy.json: include its rules by id ('graph-dag') and add this file's revocation+quorum rules.
